imagePath.description: Return EXACTLY the file name of the input image and nothing else. Do not add explanation, path prefix, or suffix. Example: KeyFrameThumbnail_cfe02bc1-b238-4732-89db-5e5d7d4305ff.jpg

description.description: Provide a short natural-language description of what is visually happening in this frame. Focus on the main subject, visible facial expression, shot composition, and notable objects. Write in Japanese. Keep it within 1-2 sentences. Do not mention uncertainty unless necessary.

subject.description: Primary visible subject of the frame.

shot_type.description: Camera shot type of the frame.

emotion.description: Overall emotional tone of the frame based on visible facial expression and scene appearance.

objects.description: Return zero or more clearly visible objects or entities from the enum list only. If none apply, return an empty list.
